title: Tonelli identity: lower integral of w(x) h(|x-y|) equals ofReal of the t-integral of Q(t)/t^n
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, mu a measure on R^(n+l), w : R^(n+l) -> R, y in R^(n+l), phi : R -> R, and R, eps, s, r real numbers. Assume eps > 0; mu(closedBall y R) < infinity; w is a.e.-strongly measurable for mu restricted to the open ball ball y R, and for mu-a.e. x, if x is in ball y R then 0 <= w(x) <= 1; phi is C^1 and nonincreasing with phi(u) = 0 for u >= 1 + eps; 0 < s <= r and (1 + eps) r < R. Write r_x := |x - y|, phi' := deriv phi and H(x) := integral_s^r -(r_x/t * phi'(r_x/t))/t/t^n dt. Then the lower integral over R^(n+l) of ofReal(w(x) H(x)) dmu equals ofReal(integral_s^r -(integral r_x/t * phi'(r_x/t) * w(x) dmu)/t/t^n dt).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (w : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (R ε s r : ℝ), 0 < ε → μ (closedBall y R) < ⊤ → AEStronglyMeasurable w (μ.restrict (ball y R)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ ball y R → 0 ≤ w x ∧ w x ≤ 1) → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Antitone φ → (∀ u : ℝ, 1 + ε ≤ u → φ u = 0) → 0 < s → s ≤ r → (1 + ε) * r < R → ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (w x * (∫ t in s..r, -(‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t)) / t / t ^ n)) ∂μ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ t in s..r, -(∫ x, ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * w x ∂μ) / t / t ^ n)
